links.why: gam ki opens cl0 as the concession ('even though I walk') and the claim 'I will fear no evil' holds anyway; concession precedes what it qualifies and attaches forward

links.why: ki after the main clause gives the reason for not fearing: 'for you are with me'
links.category: reason clause after its main clause

groups.why: cl0 is the obstacle (gam ki, walking through the valley), cl1 the claim that holds anyway, and cl2 (ki) the stated ground of that claim

cant_tell.what: How cl3 and cl4 (rod and staff, they comfort me) attach to cl2
cant_tell.why: no conjunction at cl3 and the semicolon leaves open whether they are a further ground under the same ki, the detail of 'you are with me', or a separate asyndetic statement; the form does not decide, so no elaborates or because link is added
